d:
Welcome to the official music video of the electrifying song "Baadshah O Baadshah"!
Get ready to groove to the beats of this high-energy track from the blockbuster movie Baadshah. Sung by the iconic Abhijeet Bhattacharya, this song features the King of Bollywood, Shah Rukh Khan, along with the stunning Twinkle Khanna. "Baadshah O Baadshah" is known for its catchy tune, dynamic choreography, and Shah Rukh Khan's unmatched charisma.
Song : Baadshah O Baadshah
Singer : Abhijeet
Music : Anu Malik
Lyrics : Sameer
Director : Abbas - Mustan
Producer : Bhawar Jain - Girish Jain
